name: Kotomi
source:
A woman in a lone alleyway, covered in trash. When asked what her last wish is by [url=https://vndb.org/c139556]Karuta[/url], she says that she's always lived each day like it's her last. 

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2024/05/28/karuta/]official site[/url]]
